game.title: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

lede: Kansas City Chiefs carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Kansas City Chiefs −9.0 with a fair total of 44.0, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Kansas City Chiefs pass offence vs New York Jets pass defence, which sits +0.247 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
